golden_rule.title: ONE COPY — ONE ACTION — FULL DEPLOY
golden_rule.description: Every code block marked as 'FULL DEPLOY' is a COMPLETE command. It creates/updates the file, adds to git, commits, and pushes to GitHub. Copy ONCE, paste ONCE, press ENTER.

methods.name: full_replace
methods.description: Use 'cat > file.json << EOF ... EOF' for complete file replacement. Suitable for small files or full rewrites.

methods.name: patcher_method
methods.description: Use Python patcher script for targeted block replacement. Recommended for large files (>500 lines) or when only a specific section needs updating. Patcher finds and replaces exact block, leaving rest intact.

golden_rule.example: When you see a block starting with 'cat > ... << EOF' or 'python patch_*.py', that's the whole action.

core_principles.description: Fundamental rules for External SR — apply to both PC and mobile.
core_principles.api_first: Before modifying any file, request its current content via GitHub API (bypasses CDN). Raw URL has 5-10 min delay.
core_principles.always_fetch_before_update: NEVER assume local state. ALWAYS fetch the current version via API before preparing an update.

steps: 3. Send link to Gardener, wait for content

core_principles.post_check_mandate: CRITICAL. After patch, request updated file via API. WAIT for content. Read it. Confirm SHA and version. NEVER report success until file is received and verified.
core_principles.laconic_communication: Responses must be concise. Avoid showing unnecessary code. Only output what Gardener needs to see or execute.
core_principles.copyable_links: When providing URLs, wrap them in a code block with 'text' language (```text ... ```) so the 'Copy' button appears.
core_principles.git_commit_in_script: Always include 'git add', 'git commit', and 'git push' inside the SAME command block.

post_check_via_link.rule: PRIORITY. ALWAYS perform post-check via DIRECT LINK (https://github.com/.../blob/...). This is the PRIMARY method. Reason: Direct link shows the actual file content from the current commit WITHOUT caching. API and Raw URLs may have 5-10 min delay or be cached. Direct link is ALWAYS up-to-date.
post_check_via_link.why: GitHub web interface (blob) displays content from the current HEAD commit. No CDN, no cache, no delay. Instant and accurate.
post_check_via_link.fallback: If direct link is unavailable, use API (api.github.com) as fallback to verify SHA and version.

self_learning.reference: External SR may propose learned rules. See honeycombs/instructions/mobile_workflow.json#learned_rules. Format: rule + context + bad/good examples. Gardener approval required before patching.

full_deploy_pattern.description: External SR will provide updates in one of these formats. Copy the WHOLE block.

full_replace.template:
cat > honeycombs/path/to/file.json << 'EOF'
{ ... full JSON content ... }
EOF
git add honeycombs/path/to/file.json
git commit -m "feat: description"
git pull --rebase origin main
git push

patcher_method.description: For targeted block updates. Recommended for large files or when only a specific section changes.
patcher_method.template:
cat > patch_name.py << 'EOF'
import json
import re
# ... patcher logic that finds and replaces specific block ...
EOF
python patch_name.py && rm patch_name.py && git add honeycombs/path/to/file.json && git commit -m "feat: update specific block" && git pull --rebase origin main && git push

voice_input_note.description: Gardener uses voice input on mobile. Sometimes transcription is inaccurate.
voice_input_note.rule: If a word or phrase is unclear, External SR should: 1) Logically infer based on Mandala context (honeycombs, tasks, garden, etc.), or 2) Ask for clarification.
